summary: Interest on club deposits taxable under Income Tax Act 1961; mutuality principle rejected; doctrine requires complete identity between contributors and participators; Bankipur Club de-linking of Group E explained; Cawnpore Club precedent irrelevant; Bangalore Club judgment upheld; interest from bank deposits not exempt as no mutual relationship with corporate banks; appeals dismissed.
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; High Court judgments affirmed; interest on bank deposits held taxable.
